Sunday Crumb, a small bakery, opens Saturday on First Avenue in downtown Rochester. (Demo story; this fixture exists to test that minor stories from other towns stay out of other readers' editions.)

The owners say they will start with bread, pastries, and coffee, and keep hours from 7 a.m. to 2 p.m. Wednesday through Sunday.

New bakeries are a hopeful sign for a downtown block, though early weeks are rarely a good guide to how a food business will do. Steady regulars matter more than opening day crowds.
